title: Organization settings
intro: Profile, statement details and reporting timezone for this organization.
loadError: The settings could not be loaded.
saveFailed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
conflict: Someone else saved changes. The latest values are shown; review them and save again.
lostGrant: You can no longer change this section. It is now read-only.
profileHelp: How your organization can be reached.
displayNameHelp: The name was approved by TicketBox and appears on buyer pages. To change it, contact TicketBox.
needsMembers: Only members who manage members can change this. Ask a manager of your organization.
needsMembersOrFinance: Only members who manage members or view orders and revenue can change this.
logoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB, at least 128 by 128 pixels. Shown on statements.
logoBadType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
logoTooLarge: The logo must be 2 MB or smaller.
logoTooSmall: The logo must be at least 128 by 128 pixels.
detailsHelp: Printed on settlement statements. If they are empty, statements show the display name.
taxCodeHint: 10 digits, or 10 digits, a hyphen and 3 digits.
reportingHelp: Sales reports group sales by day in this timezone. A single performance uses its own venue timezone.
